Name: Sebastian Has A Window (Sebby's Basement Room Window Addon)
Author: MissAnaira
Description:
This is a very small CP pack that adds a window to Sebastian's basement bedroom at Robin's house. It replaces where his painting was. This mod also replaces a line of dialogue that Sebastian says on Thursdays in Fall where he mentions his room being depressing from not having a window.

Special thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Abagaianye]Abagaianye[/url] and others in the Stardew Valley Discord for helping me with this!

Please note: If you use Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE), then it is recommended to use Sebby's Window v1.0.0 for the bigger window to cover the artwork.

Downloads.Description: Shortened window so that it better resembles a basement window.
